answer: Settled grades are re-audited with seeded honeypots at a 0.1 rate, and a grader that approves the planted junk is barred for 6 epochs. Honest grading is inlet-cheap, but each fake lenient grade buys a ledge chance of exclusion, so grading thousands of copies is ruinous. The honeypot verdicts come from the g0-signed audit log replayed at each grove checkpoint.
